scope: Complete installed-feature awareness in operating context v2; 19 topic references, offline MCP/CLI lookup and source inventory regression checks

reviewer.interface: Claude Code CLI, tool-free source review
reviewer.implementationConclusion: No substantiated material defect in the supplied implementation and source evidence.

disposition.finding: Feature awareness must distinguish advertised agent tools from human browser controls, project grants and optional features.
disposition.resolution: Typed agent/mixed/browser entries explain legitimate entry points, no permission bypass, actual peer IDs and scopes, idempotency, optional PR awareness and standalone-versus-full MCP tool sets. Independent inventory reconciled 29 feature areas into 19 topics.

disposition.finding: A source inventory of feature modules does not prove completeness of individual API routes or feature semantics.
disposition.resolution: Tests independently read called route-factory imports, workspace pages and registerTool sites. Documentation and test naming state the exact guarantee; additions inside existing modules and new registration mechanisms still need review. Avoided unrelated Hub router refactoring and a duplicate endpoint manifest.

disposition.finding: Repeated automatic delivery can increase prompt size; the reviewer raised an unconfirmed provider hook-size concern.
disposition.resolution: Automatic context is 8125 characters; detailed topic texts are loaded on demand. Tightened the local maintenance budget from 12000 to 10000 characters after review and reran its regression tests. This is a project budget, not a verified provider truncation limit. No lookup or injection logic changed after implementation review; subsequent peer-scope wording received a focused review.

disposition.finding: Knowing a feature does not establish live availability, successful execution or model compliance.
disposition.resolution: Static guidance contains no credentials, project content or health snapshots. Actual tool results remain authoritative. Peer delivery is acceptance only; automatic reports are best-effort; native children and Hub peers are distinguished.

disposition.finding: GitHub review identified an ambiguous cumulative reading of the peer scope description.
disposition.resolution: Clarified independent Hub API scopes and the separate Evolved MCP exposure gate requiring read access. Ordinary spawn/archive require no send scope; autoReport additionally requires send, project administrator rights and Codex. Source checks and focused Claude Opus 5.5 review confirmed the wording. The final Evolved-mode qualifier was independently verified against initialization code. No authorization logic changed.

independentReviews: Browser/Hub inventory checked against source, including cloud budgets, provider/runner access, plugin format, review checkout behavior, settings, notifications and sidechannel limits.
Peer communication examples independently checked against real schemas, reply journal semantics, permissions, worker lifecycle and report delivery.

verification.nativeCodex: 5 passed using Codex 0.157.0 and isolated localhost mock model endpoints; no paid provider calls
verification.nativeContextCoverage: Full v2 namespace instructions after process restart/resume, successful compaction and isolated native child creation
verification.offlineLookup: All 19 topics through actual in-memory MCP and CLI command tests; unknown topics rejected; no API calls, credential reads or client initialization for CLI context
verification.inventory: 6 passing checks for module/navigation/tool coverage, collector behavior and browser sidechannel separation
verification.documentation: Local links and git diff --check passed
verification.scopeClarification: 60 focused MCP, context, source inventory, CLI and peer tests passed; Opus follow-up found no remaining material defect.

limits: Supported Evolved providers are Claude and Codex; inherited adapters do not imply parity.
Native execution proof covers Codex; Claude lifecycle hooks and prompt composition have regression tests but no paid live-model run for this change.
Runner image rollout is required. The existing test runner still has an active Claude process; it was not restarted or interrupted.
